title: Fisher Simplicity in Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks and Multilayer Perceptrons
abstract: arXiv:2609.32503v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) are motivated in part by interpretability: their learned edge functions can be inspected, pruned, and reduced to symbolic structure. In a fixed-basis KAN, this makes a small or zero basis coefficient look like a certificate of simplicity, much as a dead rectified linear unit (ReLU) marks unused computation in a multilayer perceptron (MLP). Fisher nullity gives a precise statistical notion: a parameter direction is Fisher-simple exactly when perturbing it is invisible under the task distribution. We study when these architectural and Fisher notions agree.   For a dead ReLU unit, they agree: the closed activation region makes the associated score directions vanish. For a fixed-basis KAN, they do not. In the single-layer Gaussian case, the coefficient Fisher matrix is a basis Gram matrix under the input distribution and is independent of the fitted coefficients. translated_title: 科尔莫哥洛夫-阿诺德网络与多层感知机中的Fisher简单性
translated_abstract: Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KAN）的部分动机源自可解释性：其学习到的边函数可以被检查、剪枝，并约化为符号结构。在固定基函数的KAN中，这使得小或为零的基系数看起来像是简单性的证明，正如失效的修正线性单元（ReLU）标记了多层感知机（MLP）中未被使用的计算一样。Fisher零空间给出了一个精确的统计学概念：当一个参数方向在任务分布下受到扰动不可见时，它恰好是Fisher简单的。我们研究了这些架构性概念与Fisher概念何时一致。对于失效的ReLU单元，两者是一致的：封闭的激活区域使相关的得分方向消失。对于固定基函数的KAN，两者并不一致。在单层高斯情形下，系数Fisher矩阵是输入分布下的基Gram矩阵，并且与拟合的系数无关。在多层KAN中，Fisher简单性……
tldr: 该论文研究了架构简单性与Fisher统计简单性何时一致，发现失效ReLU单元中两者一致（得分方向消失），但在固定基函数的KAN中两者并不一致，其系数Fisher矩阵与拟合系数无关。
en_tdlr: This paper investigates when architectural simplicity agrees with Fisher simplicity, showing they align for dead ReLU units in MLPs—where score directions vanish—but diverge for fixed-basis KANs, whose coefficient Fisher matrix is independent of the fitted coefficients.
